title: Special Executive Programme In Consumer Behaviour
description: The course aims to give students a comprehensive understanding of consumer behaviour and its impact on marketing strategies.
longDescription: This course dives into the complexities of consumer decision-making, factors influencing buying behavior, and key consumer behavior theories. Students will gain the tools to analyze customer insights and develop strategies to enhance customer experience in both organizational and technological contexts.
courseDetails: Students will explore consumer behavior models, decision-making risks, and the role of technology in shaping consumer choices. The course covers customer relationship management, marketing research fundamentals, and the use of communication strategies to manage customer experiences effectively. modules.title: Consumer Behaviour
modules.summary: This course introduces students to the study of consumer behavior, focusing on the decision-making process, behavioral models, and customer experience management. It emphasizes the role of technology in influencing consumer actions and provides practical insights into marketing research methods and strategies for understanding and managing customer relationships.
